privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: Wegen Guide works without an account and does not ask for your name, email or phone number.
privacy.p2: Your checklists, reminders, trip history and saved offices are stored only on your phone. We do not upload or store them on our servers.
privacy.p3: We use your location only when you tap a location button, only to find offices near you and to show a route. It stays on your phone; we do not store or upload your location history. When you request a route or a map, the necessary coordinates are sent to Google Maps.
privacy.p4: Community tips and office suggestions are anonymous and are reviewed by moderators before publishing.
privacy.p5: The app uses Google Maps (Maps JavaScript API and Directions/Routes API) to show offices and guide you there. Google handles that data under Google's privacy policy.
privacy.p6: Voice reading uses your device's built-in speech engine. It works on your phone and does not send your screen text to us.
